description_en: Modifies the switchover time of a scheduled O&M event for an instance
description_zh: 修改实例计划内运维事件的切换时间
name: ModifyActiveOperationTasks

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html operation to query the region information of all clusters under the target account
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html接口查看目标账号下所有的集群的地域信息
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The planned switchover time to set. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC).


The time cannot be later than the deadline.
You can call the DescribeActiveOperationTasks operation and obtain the deadline from the Deadline response parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要设置的计划切换时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。


不能晚于最晚操作时间。
您可以调用 DescribeActiveOperationTasks，通过返回参数 Deadline 的值来获取最晚操作时间
parameters.name: switch_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to immediately start execution scheduling.

0: No (default).
1: Yes.

If the value is 0, the SwitchTime parameter is required.
If the value is 1, the SwitchTime parameter does not take effect. The event start time is set to the current time, and the switchover time is automatically calculated based on the new start time. The event immediately enters execution scheduling (not an immediate switchover) and begins pre-switchover preparations. The switchover is performed after the preparations are complete. You can call the DescribeActiveOperationTasks operation and obtain the preparation time from the PrepareInterval response parameter
parameters.help_zh:
是否立即进入执行调度。

0：否 (默认) 。
1: 是。

取值为0时switchTime要求必填；
值为 1 时 switchTime 不生效，事件开始时间将设置为当前时间，切换时间根据新的开始时间自动计算。 事件立即进入执行调度（并非立即切换），进行切换的前置准备，准备完成后，进行切换。您可以调用 DescribeActiveOperationTasks，通过返回参数 PrepareInterval 的值来获取准备时间
parameters.name: immediate_start
